description: This file defines the LogConsistencyProvider class, which implements a log consistency scheme for Orleans' event sourcing, enabling multiple clusters to connect via shared primary storage and managing log views using storage providers.

classes.name: LogConsistencyProvider
classes.description: A log-consistency provider that stores the latest view in primary storage, supporting multiple clusters and optimistic concurrency.

methods.name: UsesStorageProvider
methods.description: Indicates that this provider uses storage provider for persistence.

methods.name: MakeLogViewAdaptor
methods.description: Creates an instance of LogViewAdaptor for managing log views and state.

calls: new LogViewAdaptor<TView, TEntry>(hostGrain, initialState, grainStorage, grainTypeName, services)
